newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei plunges below key 19,000 level by end.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei plunges below key 19,000 level by end.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index closed below the key psychological level of 19,000 on Tuesday. Despite the yen's recovery against the dollar and Wall Street's rally to all-time highs overnight, the market was beset by lingering worries over the economy.
Declining issues overwhelmed advancers 853 to 236, while 128 issues were unchanged.
In other indices, the TOPIX index of all first section stocks dropped 27.81 points or 1.88 percent to close at 1,453.05. The Nikkei 300 average ended 5.85 points or 2.07 percent lower at 276.60.
In the morning, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said that an excessively weak or strong yen is not favourable for the Japanese economy.
"We will continue to act properly against excessive currency moves," Mitsuzuka added.
